FLOOD ALERT IN NCR

The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority says there continues to be reported flooding in Parañaque City after the heavy rainfall on Saturday, Sept. 6. 

The situation in Parañaque City as of 3:18 p.m.:

+ Dr. A. Santos Ave. in front of SM Sucat, Paranaque City. Knee deep. Not passable to light vehicles.

+ Dr. A.Santos Ave. near Paranaque National Highschool. Gutter deep. Passable to all types of vehicles.

+ Dr. A. Santos Ave. Corner Canaynay Ave. Brgy. San Dionisio, Paranaque City (over flow of Villanueva Creek): Gutter deep. Passable to all types of vehicles.

Meanwhile, the MMDA says the flood in Roxas Blvd. Pedro Gil in Manila City and Roxas Edsa Intersection NB in Pasay City has subsided. 

📸 MMDA/Facebook
